name: ROBBINSDALE ENTERTAINMENT CENTER

violations.description: Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager Terry Berg had an expired certificate.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil * was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. Scoop handle laying in product in Flour bin

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of food contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Cutting boards have deep grooves that are holding debris/ black in color. Not cleanable. May need to be replaced or resurfaced.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface all RICoolers and Microwave were not cleaned as frequently as required.--Nonfood contact surface RIFreezers were not cleaned as frequently as required.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution between uses. -Wet cloth sitting on prep table.--In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. -Scoop handle sitting on product in sugar bin.
Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. -Pizza prep cooler at 44-47F.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Clean inside ice machine.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean circulation fans in kitchen.
